resolved_intents.intent: Perform valid login with username and password

missing_methods.intent: Scroll to Contact Us or Support link in footer
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Scroll down to the footer section of the dashboard page and ensure the Contact Us or Support link is visible in the viewport.

missing_methods.intent: Click Contact Us or Support link in footer
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and click the Contact Us or Support link in the footer section of the dashboard page. This should navigate to the support portal.
Verify that the support portal page has loaded successfully by checking for a unique element or page title that confirms the user is on the support portal.
Locate the subject input field on the support portal form and enter the provided subject text. Parameters: subject_text (string) - the subject line for the support request.
Locate the message input field or text area on the support portal form and enter the provided message text. Parameters: message_text (string) - the detailed message content for the support request.
Locate and click the submit button on the support portal form to submit the support request.

missing_methods.intent: Wait for success confirmation message to be visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the success confirmation message element to become visible on the page after form submission. Use an explicit wait with appropriate timeout.

Assert that the success confirmation message is displayed on the page and optionally verify the message text contains expected confirmation content (e.g., 'Your request has been submitted successfully').
